summary: The 8-K reports two items: (1) an unregistered sale of ~2.025 million common shares at $24.687/share (total $50 million) under Regulation D/Regulation S to accredited/non-U.S. persons, exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2); and (2) the NAV per share as of March 31, 2026 ($24.687), aggregate NAV ($516.1M), portfolio value ($1,012.9M), and debt outstanding ($516.8M, 1.00x debt-to-equity). This is a routine capital raise (shelf takedown) and NAV disclosure, not a special situation. No strategic event, tender offer, or restructuring is involved.
